title: Client Emit Request
description: Requests a typed client be emitted for a published manifest already staged as a digest-pinned read.

manifest_ref_id.description: The read id of the neuron.published-manifest/v1 artifact to emit a client for.

format.description: ts/js: a frontend-consumable module exporting the pinned contract and a request helper. json: the same contract as a plain data document, for callers generating their own bindings.

client_name.description: Optional identifier used to name the emitted export/artifact. Defaults to the manifest id.
